name: ok-web
description: Web-project setup as a personal, user-scoped plugin — /setup-web sets up a project's agent-facing web tooling (starting with the chrome-devtools-mcp browser server) and /setup-dom-picker sets up the dev-only DOM picker in the project's frontends; the intake point for future web MCPs and utilities. Setup only: nothing lands in the project beyond the configuration and dev tooling the skills write
